notes.title: Devblog Update 7 - Alpha 3 complete! Alpha 4 now begins
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!  I want to first apologize for the delayed dev blog this month - I decided to hold off a bit because I was close to finishing Alpha 3 goals and wanted to finish first before posting!



I made a lot of progress this month!  I'm very excited to show you all the progress down below.  I'm hoping to do a new trailer for the game soon because we've improved almost every single element of the game since the original trailer launch!



With Alpha 3 wrapping up, I'll begin moving into Alpha 4 and its goals!  I won't list everything here since I'm still organizing my A4 plans, but here's some of the big ticket items - 

New Biome (I won't spoil till I have something to show you)

New Shop Expansion/Upgrade

Add a lot more fish for the new biome

The Government (No spoilers yet, but this is add a difficulty element)

Basic World Map to replace the fast travel menu

Town Level 3

Customer Level 3

If things feel too overwhelming or I feel like progress is going slow on some parts, I'll shift some of these goals for Alpha 5!  A part of working on this is learning how to prioritize goals.



Something I can't show you but also got added - Footsteps sounds!  


Fishing Rod 2.0
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d8bb3076415a788a4520f87acad2b96809883e91.gif"]

Overheat mechanic!  If you reel for too long - The fishing line will snap!  We need to now adjust the reel time on the fish and have certain fish have higher reel times.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/e720bef90791e95366a2dabb4770a5ba8a637e49.gif"]

The rod will now snap if you walk too far away from your lure after you've cast it

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/e36d727f0fa14010951f6f163e5260c29489c5de.gif"]

You get a little ːsteamthumbsupː animation when you get a new record!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/20a2f6e9a477536911740622d3679f340db6b923.gif"]

The rod now moves/wiggles a bit when your walking!  I hope to get this working for the rest of your inventory later.


Weather System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/cf01c9ade31a824b129a7051d562abbac428ea2a.gif"]

This is not just a visual thing - This is gameplay - On rainy days, certain fish are now catchable (The halibut and tuna that got added recently for example)

I hope to make rainy days look more foggy and dimmer soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/76721d77b3f7e29752c4d0f1f750894c0a235161.gif"]

Clear days!  I replaced the old generic skybox with a nicer one now
Town Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/dcf90c6732e9792a28d0173fa273043af4f570a8.gif"]

Level 1 Houses - The Vagabonds - Feels much better now and feels more like a community is growing around you

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/6559ee2aaf6fbe19a2e771c70512a76d8e839447.gif"]

Level 2 Houses - The Shanty - These will start spawning level 2 customers, who have better buying power!  



I want to do another pass on this in the future, I really want the town to have personality to it.  I'd love for you to see other businesses starting up in the area.
Customer Lvl 2
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/91db474acd278a3a5574e3e58984c816f82e6834.gif"]

You'll see these lads spawn from the Shanty parts of town!  They have more buying power than the vagabonds.  
New Fish - Tuna & Cod
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d4d7e1ed1c566e0a980db9ec7af2d8991f388916.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/6a61b4910e682945d52e4ab23be08eb214fc3771.gif"]
New Building Crates
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/9f9f488eb84dbe5d681f932f9828f298bb70ae2f.gif"]


Home region 2.0
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/3090ab29081cbec7048d5b20d74c7861119dd128.gif"]

The starting player region finally got some love, it had a lot of proxy art before that I never had time to replace.  I'm very happy with the direction this is going, this isn't finished by any means, I really look forward to adding more elements to 'The Old World' ruins and character.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/071d0aebb5326c9e7e267194c947f761e0b0abb5.gif"]
Ocean Biome 2.0
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/6f5a7e4c9d476b05ff7e313df14c50b82def4f16.gif"]

The cove was added into the ocean biome!  You can catch different saltwater fish in this spot

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/3de1c8609b65655d46a67113ee271dacecc6a159.gif"]

Finally got to finish other parts of the beach!  I wanted to have landers and making it look more like a mid-battle landing was just occurring

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/2f8abefbf750124f5899c8ec7361228332c0bd7c.gif"]

Some fun little lore bits getting added into the world finally


Holographic Fishes added
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/50d4a3648615458457c9330ee052e5c8403d01e5.gif"]

Finally had time to add holographic rares for all our fish!  There is a graphical issue with the wahoo and red snapper, so I've held off on adding those yet.  I need to balance how much these will be worth in the end, and the rarity of some will be much harder to get than others.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/88f1ebda91bd057f00700de1b0befdeb4056cae3.gif"]

Dog finally got some heart particles as well - No more generic ♥ text

notes.title: Devblog Update 6 - Shop Content
notes.notes:
Hello!  This month has been going really well and I've been super jazzed up and inspired by people playing the demo and joining the discord.  I've managed to get the demo in a more stable place, and my focus is now on 'Alpha 3' which is more content focused now. 



The shop needed some love and attention, so I improved the build mode and added a bunch of new things to buy and use in the shop.  I'm wrapping up shop content for now - It's not finished yet, but we need to move onto other areas that also need more content now (It also gives me time to add more ideas/plans for future shop content).



I'm now moving onto the town mechanic, which also really needs some love.  It 'works' but it's very non-exciting at the moment.  I'm already making progress on it, but I'll show you on the next update post.  I want there to be a more neat looking town that builds around your shop and it feels more alive.




Demo Progress
I've been working on patching and stabilizing the demo as much as possible while still trying to focus on content as well!  I try to focus on 'Game breaking issues' 

New people have been joining the new discord after the demo launch and its been SUPER helpful getting some early feedback and bugs/issues! 

 It's also just very inspiring seeing people interested and playing my game, I can't emphasize this enough coming from larger companies where I just felt like part of a giant factory

Minor Bugs - I'm chipping away at them, but some I am putting off because I have plans to overhaul or improve certain mechanics (Like the fishing rod) 

Now that the demo is more stable, I won't be pushing updates to it constantly.  I have a beta-branch which I will be pushing experimental mechanics and features.  Once we know those features are working as intended I can update demo

I'm going to treat the demo like we are in early access.  I think it's important to build a community with it and get it into a really good solid place.  Down the road I'll have to figure out how to put in a demo cutoff, but for now getting people to play the game I think is way more valuable as I develop it all

I still wouldn't recommend the demo for most gamers yet - I'd love to do my 2.0 pass on the fishing rod and get the town content improved first.  I'm still a bit worried/hesitant to do the fishing rod improvements until I have a really good plan in place; Don't break what's working

These fishtanks also display the name of your fish on the monitors, and their value

The green buttons you see will let you change their decoration options (I'll add more options later)

You can choose to pull out specific fish (By hitting E on the icon) or just pulling them out rapidly
Fish Scale

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d94b4e125b6bed142d39622f6e3009f47342db52.gif"]

The fish scale tells you the weight and price of your fish in case you forget

It also ADDS a 10% bonus value to the fish once

I'll make fancier scales for future upgrades that give a higher value bonus
Shop Lights Mechanic
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/38b04b3594c9909c93830648bd44d1f6f2fc647e.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/02e31958c4b47777f348b305a16dd928d95b7da1.gif"]

Some of the players have mentioned how dark it gets at night time especially in your store, so I focused on adding in a light mechanic now

The lights will flicker when they turn on at first - Later on stores will have nicer quality lights!

You'll have lightswitches in the store to turn the lights on/off

I added a power generator beside the shop purely for atmosphere, it turns on/off when you have the lights on/off
New Fish
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d07d06fca747fae97d1bcb062e3f7a0b7a5551dd.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d6eba937e54b9c9cc1220535a9caebfeadcbdd50.gif"]

First GIGA catch added - Manatee

Halibut is in engine, but not in game yet - I am going to make a cove area in the ocean biome where you can find it

No matter what focus I'm doing on the game, on the side I'll continue to keep working on fish and adding them to build up our database
Foil/Rare Fish look improved
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/38b34613edbfcecab281cf2c52e1bdde214203d5.gif"]

Much happier with the rare look now!

I now need to start adding in all the rare alts of all the other fish, right now the carp is the only fish with one.  I did this for testing purposes first
Shop Decorations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/17be830e25d17e5990337dd1efb41a4d99325fea.gif"]

Added in a rug! All the props are gonna be more 'worn' and 'apocalypse' looking at the start, later on as you build up a nicer store, they'll look less grungy 

I want to add in way more decoration options for you to decorate the store with, but my focus mostly was on gameplay props for your shop.  Decorative stuff is a bit lower priority until later on
Build Mode improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/0c9467b52fc4b6cab7d962aa80246351976e1d0a.gif"]

Better at detecting 'not allowed' areas now, it's not perfect but much better!  I'll keep doing passes on all mechanics over time to keep improving them

notes.title: Devblog Update 5 - Alpha 2 goals finished! Alpha 3 begins
notes.notes:
Edit - Our discord (The original link I didn't realize discord puts a expiry on, updated and fixed it now!)



Hello folks! For this devblog update I finished some big goals for the game!  I focused on wrapping up what I called 'Alpha 2' which focused on finishing our core systems, and getting the game stable enough for a very rough early demo!  I did this so the game could get a bit better promoted in the steam fishing festival.  Now that the systems are in place, I can begin moving into 'Alpha 3' and focus on content, which is way more exciting to show to people!




Demo Launch
The demo is now officially accessible on the main store page! However I caution against trying it out yet - The game has very little content/polish since I had to build the skeleton first.  It's more of a 'Do you like the idea of this game?'   

I'd wait to try the demo when we've made enough progress in Alpha 3 and I've gotten much more content for the shop, town and biomes

I will put out patches to the demo over time; But I will mostly be focusing on the beta branch so the players can test it first and make tweaks/fixes

Once the content looks stable, I'll push it onto the demo and we'll keep building up a stronger early game for people to experience

We now have a discord, you can join via the link on the page here if you are interested in joining the beta branch or just have questions or suggestions for the game (Especially for fish ideas)
Shop Level 3
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/4d3d2cc4622636dcb08b1a794091d7cfc91ac85c.gif"]

I plan on doing another pass on this shop!  I want to have a better fish sign, and I need to get doors for it still

Way more floor space

Unlocks better furniture for your store that isn't made out of cardboard and feeling like a hobo! You got a roof over your head now
Display Shelf Level 2 & New Animation[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/5a386b36b3dca1b0d31f4a2319038282b5c3c90b.gif"]
I'm actually not happy with the art direction of this, I plan on overhauling it down the road - But it works which is the most important thing! It holds up to 3 fish and displays your fish price

Made a very janky animation of you tossing the fish onto the shelf, just adds a bit of fun to it!

I think the redesign should be more metal-ish and not plywood, this kinda doesn't match the store it unlocks with

I'll keep the model still, and maybe this could simply be another shelf to let you choose from - I'm all about variety in simulator games
Bait Boosters[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/cf892b9c794155b4d7a9d4893fd83d0f070a688b.gif"]
This is still very early and rough; I want to do cooler animations and effects! I definitely want a good dopamine factor going on

Later on, we might experiment with you having a chance to pull some kind of super-bait
Tutorial
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/eea23d3aab8f7ff99093bbd9dd85236da23d92bf.png"]

Very very rough tutorial right now!  I'll keep it rough because the game is in alpha and will keep evolving

When I get into Beta, then I'll replace images with little videos instead
Title Announcer[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/51241b9ef7dc27e981cb1046f5debf13b952dde2.gif"]
Totally not needed, but I love the idea of some cinema in my janky game - Hopefully gives you a bit of chills knowing you entered a new biome
Unlocking Biomes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/317fa51370a36f4a9924bfbd20e42c66fe03d7dc.gif"]

Very rough and silly looking right now! But it works, and that's what was most important

You currently pay money to blast open a blocked off area, which leads you to the ocean biome

Later on I'd love to have a shady NPC show up, and you have to talk to him and offer him money to blow open the entrances

Your home region will be like a central hub which connects more and more to the biomes
Alpha 3 Content
Now that we finished all my Alpha 2 goals, we are moving into Alpha 3 which is way more content focused

This also can mean improving mechanics (The fishing rod, NPC's, etc)

More fish, more shop props, more NPC's are planned

I want to start making the town that builds around your shop look really interesting

Make biomes more interesting and having lots of cool areas to explore to find fishing spots

Here is some of the items I've gotten done already for Alpha 3

The hidden pond - Located in the Ocean biome, this is tucked away in the forest

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/6612e5593a55fbec7e3087f45472174059fab813.gif"]

New Fish - Giga Guppy!  This will be a bit of a rarer catch to find in the hidden pond

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/a6e61b48b5f81dae8f033d724f6fe5da4b723f52.gif"]
Save System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/f21173b31b6dcc3d48f907317ec4e50c3fc12dca.png"]

This is very ugly right now - But it was a huge victory to get this working properly!  You can now have as many save files as you want

When you save a game, it moves to the top of the list

Time stamps for your save file - Really happy this is working its a nice quality-of-life for users

notes.title: Devblog Update 4 - Early Alpha Testing | Day/Night | Music
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! For this months dev post, I wanted to update you on the biggest amount of progress the game has made.  It's not a lot of visual progress; so not a lot of screenshots.  I have been really focused on very early alpha tests!  This has helped me so much... I now have the game in a stable (Not perfect) situation and it really helps give me focus for the game.  

The fishing festival requires you to have a demo, so I hope I can have a small demo that can show the game.  I'm hoping this will be a good way to make sure I've actually made something fun that people want to play! 

I will keep rolling out the early alpha over time (Currently on my twitch discord, in the future I will create a new discord specifically for the game), currently I'm doing this with my twitch community.  I don't recommend for most people to try it at this point - I'm getting all the systems stable but it still lacks content.  I'm hoping with a few weeks away from the fishing festival, I can now focus more on content and get some more upgrades/props for the store and fish to catch.

Early Alpha Testing


 This is huge!  I have begun rolling out some keys to friends and twitch viewers to begin playing the game
 I had to learn how to get the game uploaded to steam, it was a bit confusing at first but now I'm used to it.  It's good early training to get used to when the game is actually live or when I have a lot more people playing the active development
 Getting people to play it now has helped dramatically, I've begun building a proper gameplay loop now and it's a great way to have focus
 Lots of bugs had to be fixed, there was a bunch of issues with the customer AI that I learnt.  Tons of UI issues and just making things feel better - I'm not a UI artist so its a challenge for me, my rule is keep the UI as simple and clean as possible
 Reeling the fish has been totally redone, while it was funny to have fish launched at you with full physics, people were loosing fish everywhere and it was super glitchy.  It's not fun to get a big catch and then loose it!  I made a more stable way of pulling the fish out and it lands right in front of you safely on the ground
 Fish catch rates are redone and super visually easy for me to see % rates and adjust them now.  This will be really nice for balancing purposes.  I feel like a corpo casino manager who needs to tune the winnings


Day/Night System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/41304d157079112046abc4fd36620acb0bd32ab6.gif

 Since the game has stabilized in the early alpha, I've begun moving back onto content.  I just got this working this weekend!  I now have a timer system that also controls the day/night lighting
 At the end of the day, you get a 'end of day report' which shows you the amount of fish sold for the day, and the amount of profit you've made.  I'll keep building this up for other stats over time.
 When your end of day report happens, you spawn back at your shop.  I'd like to try and animate your character yawning and blacking out/falling asleep.  I'll try to add in a bed mechanic to help fast-forward you to end of day as a future mechanic!
 There is also 'Gross Profit' and 'Total fish sold' for the entire game.  There is a stats page on the console near your store where you can track that stuff!
 As posted above, I've also started collecting stats now.  We'll keep adding more to this.  I'd LOVE to get graph charts working, I think its cool to visually see that, but no promises I'm very new to coding!  It would be super cool though, I think as simulator/tycoon gamers we love seeing graph charts and numbers go up/down
 In the future I will keep building this system more.  I plan on having some fish only catchable at certain times of day (Morning/Night fish for example).  I am also thinking customers won't spawn to your store too early or too late at night either


Music

 This was super unexpected and I kind of thought I'd have to go the route of not having music!  
 Kronlid from my community had some software and equipment and very quickly hashed out some music that I felt actually fit in the world!  I finally figured out the genre that fits for the game, I believe its called 'bitcrushed' when you have music that feels a bit 'compressed' so that it fits with the weird lowrez/PSX style I'm doing
 When I do a new trailer in the future you'll be able to hear some of it! (I'd like to do a new trailer before the steam fishing fest demo)
 He hasn't posted it on his youtube yet, until he's obviously happy with the music
 Kronlids Music Channel


The next devblog I'll try to post before the steam fishing festival starts!  I'm hoping to push myself before the cutoff and try to get in some content I've been really wanting to add to the game!  If your interested or want to see the game live or have questions, follow my twitch and ask me live, or my socials and I'll definitely try to respond when I can!

notes.title: Devblog Update 3 - Town growth | Options | Demo Prep
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Apologies on a bit of a delay with this post.  I'm again very pro 'Only show you something when it's real and functioning' but what I might do in the future if I have a busy month or no visual progress, is just at least do a small bi-monthly post mentioning the things I'm doing.

Town growth mechanic

 I now have a system in place for the town that will begin growing around your shop - When you start feeding the other homeless wanderers around you, more tents/shacks will begin moving in!
 When more people move in, the more often customers will begin showing up near your shop
 When you get your shops 'cozy bonus' high enough from decorating, the NPC houses will start upgrading into nicer quality homes (I need to still make nicer home models looking forward to that).
 In the future, I plan on having higher quality homes spawn higher tier NPCs who will have better buying power, or also unlock certain unique buildings or NPCs

 Get the game into a demo state, and keep improving the early game loop until its very solid

 Foil Art Achievement cards
 Do a art pass on the starting region
 Get level 2 display tables to sell fish on
 More fish, always more fish

notes.title: Devblog Update 2 - Ocean Biome, Achievements, Cozy System
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!  I just wanted to share with you some of the progress I've been making on the game this month.  



 I plan on doing a newer trailer/video showing all the new stuff I've been cooking up!  
 The last major systems I need to get working are options (Like sound controls and graphic settings) and the debt/payment mechanic (Which I'll reveal once I have it working).  
 Then I'll begin prepping the game for early alpha tests to make sure the game is fun and everything is working as intended!




Ocean Biome

The ocean biome is in a very solid place now, this will be a area that you'll unlock to start catching saltwater type fish.  I wanted to at least have one new region to unlock before I start demoing the game out!  
I now need to start making a bunch of saltwater-type fish to catch here (Red-Snapper is my first to do).  If you have ideas for cool fish, please let me know in comments or on my socials!

Scroll to the bottom of the page to see a video I posted on youtube showing it a bit better, though I've added a bunch more to it since that video  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/fe4896840ff1926f8364c488d5c4187b3d545499.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/0d42e4144eac1b4413a56f4d01131c153fc6a1e7.gif

Decoration/Cozy System

Decoration/cozy system working really well now!  The higher your cozy score is, the more likely customers will spawn.  It's properly tied to the customer system now.
I have started working on the actual decoration props now, you'll see these props below are a bit... hobo-feeling since you're homeless at the start.  
When you get your shop in better shape, you'll unlock better quality decorations which will give a better cozy bonus (Which means more customers, and richer customers).

Achievievements/Records

Achievements are now fully working!  
Please ignore the ugly proxy art, I plan on doing a nicer job!  I want to make them feel fun to collect.
My plan is to make the records/fish look like trading cards - I enjoy collecting cards as a hobby and loved the idea of sneaking this into the game.  
It will keep track of your biggest catch, and the total amount caught.  
I plan on having fish descriptions also added, maybe to give hints on how to catch them more often.
I hope in the future to have more stats on this page, like your profits, total sales and etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/c7c43f00b7d8e7ec128931eec94169f88e11eeb6.png

Fishtank System

This will be the main way you increase your shops cozy bonus, and a reason for wanting to catch all types of fish!
You get a cozy point for each fish type you display (You won't get more cozy points for displaying the same type of fish).  
Rare variants will give a higher cozy bonus if displayed... but you'll also be tempted to sell them for big money.

notes.title: Devblog Update 1 - New region, decoration system & more!
notes.notes:
Hi folks; I've been busy working away on getting progress done on the game!  I plan on doing a official update post for it soon.  I'll try to do a weekly or bi-weekly post of any general progress - even if there's been very little progress I'll just keep the post short.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45475716/d1fe10348c36befc02e6ea0d9e645cc782aeaa53.gif


 New Region system added
This will allow me to load/unload as many extra areas or regions as we want.  I wanted to get this working early before I plan on making lots of areas for you to explore.
 Improved the store system
The store was super basic before, I had to manually type everything in.  Now I have one 'Master List' where I put the items and their prices, icon, description and title in.  I want this to be very flexible because I imagine I'm going to be changing prices a lot while I balance the game.
 Water system added
I didn't have a water system figured out yet, but now I do! Its working really nicely and it's going to let me make all kinds of shapes/waterfalls/bodies of water that I need.
 Decoration/Cozy System added
Its really basic at the moment, but this is now working.  When you place decoration props down, they make your shop more appealing, which then increases the chances of customers spawning.  I really enjoy the idea of rewarding you for placing props/decorating the store.  I also have a cap per type of decoration, so you can't just spam 20 carpets (Well you can, but they won't stack the cozy bonus!)
 Fast Travel system added
This was important to get working on early in the game, when you unlock and discover a new region, fast travel gets unlocked for that area.  This will also help me test the areas more easily!
 Making art for the first region (Ocean Biome)
Very excited for this, I've been spending my time now getting this ready before I officially post a official update on here.  I also plan on designing a few ocean-type fish to catch here (Red Snapper, Wahoo, Sailfish are some ideas).  You'll see in the gif I posted a part of the new ocean area... you'll walk your way down the creeks to the ocean - This is still a WIP but its making solid progress!


That's it for now! When I finish up the ocean biome and the fish for it, I'll do a small video showing the new stuff that's been added.
